notes.title: New game about Zorg's expanded universe.
notes.notes:
In this new game Eye Of Plunder, we will be able to play and have fun with the powers of Purple Plunder, a dreaded creature,  kings and wealthy people of Fortuna Land have a lot of headache when it appears in their backyards.

You can see this new game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170030/Eye_Of_Plunder/
